When the resident asks, Li Na feels confused, and Ali starts to check if there is a mistake, finally finds out it is his own mistake.

[Question]
What kind of emotion does Ali feel after realizing that he might have mishandled the specially marked clothes?

B. Ali possibly feels proud because he thinks he helps to complete an important task.
